request: mix: CSVやテキスト中の絵文字など4バイト文字を位置付きで報告 / ファイルまたは標準入力を行ごとに調べ、絵文字を含むUTF-8で4バイトになる文字、異体字セレクタ、ゼロ幅接合子を見つけて「行:桁 U+1F600」の形で報告する。CSVの場合に備え、-c を付けると列番号も併記する。見つかれば終了コード1、なければ0。古いMySQLのutf8やShift_JIS変換で壊れる文字を事前に探す用途。例: 「3行目: 「こんにちは😀」は 3:6 U+1F600 と出る。コマンド名は u4scan

spec.name: u4scan
spec.summary: u4scan reports characters that break in old MySQL utf8 or Shift_JIS conversion (4-byte UTF-8 characters, variation selectors, zero width joiner) with line and column.

flags.name: c
flags.help: CSV mode: also print the 1-based CSV column number of each finding

behavior: B1: Input is the files named as arguments, read in order; with no file arguments it is stdin. Input is split into lines on \n; one trailing \r on a line is removed. A final line without \n is still a line. Line numbers start at 1 and restart for each file. Empty input produces no output.
B2: Each line is decoded as UTF-8 and scanned rune by rune. Column is the 1-based rune index in the line (not bytes). An invalid UTF-8 byte counts as one rune and is never reported.
B3: A rune is reported if its code point is >= U+10000, or in U+FE00..U+FE0F, or in U+E0100..U+E01EF, or equals U+200D.
B4: Each finding is one stdout line "LINE:COL U+XXXX", XXXX being uppercase hex with at least 4 digits. Findings are in order of line, then column.

B5: With -c the finding line is "LINE:COL col N U+XXXX". N is 1 plus the number of commas before that rune in the line that are outside double quotes; every double quote rune toggles the in-quotes state (the quote itself is not a comma). Each line is evaluated independently, starting not-in-quotes.
B6: When more than one file is named, every finding line is prefixed with "FILE:" (the file name as given), e.g. "b.txt:1:2 U+1F600". With one file or stdin there is no prefix.
B7: If a file cannot be opened or read, print "u4scan: " followed by a message naming the file to stderr, continue with the remaining files, and exit 1 at the end.
B8: Exit code is 0 if nothing was found and no error occurred, 1 if any finding or any read error occurred, 2 on usage error (unknown flag; the flag package message goes to stderr).
B9: Nothing is written except to stdout and stderr; files are only read.
